channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder Daily Camera (dailycamera.com)

item.title: Privacy activists call on California to remove covert license plate readers
item.description: Critics argue this surveillance may violate the Fourth Amendment.

item.title: Longmont’s improvements to Roosevelt Park set to begin next week
item.description: Construction, that and includes a new kids' play area and adult fitness course. is expected to take about three months.

item.title: Grieving mother demands answers nearly 2 years after Florida deputy fatally shot airman
item.description: The deputy, Eddie Duran, was charged with manslaughter.

item.title: Moderna says FDA refuses its application for new mRNA flu vaccine
item.description: Moderna received a “refusal-to-file” letter, objecting to its clinical trial methods.

item.title: CU Buffs women’s basketball locked in for visit to last-place Houston
item.description: Coming off a big win against a top-15 opponent that was leading the conference, the Colorado women’s basketball team could be due for a letdown. Head coach JR Payne doesn’t have much doubt about her team being locked in for a road trip to last-place Houston on Wednesday night, however.

item.title: Close Maduro ally pardoned by Biden once again a target of US criminal investigation
item.description: Alex Saab is under scrutiny again for his involvement in Venezuela's CLAP program.

item.title: Federal judge dismisses attempt to obtain Michigan voter data in latest rejection of DOJ
item.description: The DOJ sued at least 23 states and the District of Columbia for voter data.

item.title: French prosecutor searches for victims after a man is accused of abusing 89 minors over 55 years
item.description: Jacques Leveugle has been under investigation since February 2024.

item.title: Former federal prosecutor who quit amid Trump administration dispute now representing Don Lemon
item.description: Joe Thompson recently formed a law firm with Harry Jacobs, another former prosecutor who quit.

item.title: Lyons girls basketball continues its rise with win over Flatirons Academy
item.description: Over the past few seasons, Lyons girls basketball has taken on a similar identity to Rome — it wasn’t built in a day, but the final product is something to behold.
